dogecoin.text:
What is Dogecoin's inherent value? Spit, piss, and wind.

The transnational elite knows that most of those into crypto are fickle amateurs. Doge is bait in a trap. 

They want you wrecked and they want you out of XRP. The closer to the XRP moonshot, the harder the Doge pump.
Two of the truly infinite things in this universe are human stupidity and the ability of $DOGE to inflate it's circulating supply. Both have a symbiotic relationship with each other.
